ios.desc:
JAKT – Your Personal AI Fitness Coach
Take your workouts to the next level with JAKT – a personalized fitness app powered by AI. Whether you're training for strength, building habits, or staying consistent, JAKT understands your data and guides you like a real coach.

What You Get:
AI-Powered Coaching
Get advice tailored to your fitness goals, workout history, and physical stats.

Smart Workout Calendar
See your progress at a glance. Every completed workout is tracked, every rest day accounted for.

Custom Routines
Build your own workouts or let the AI design programs based on your body and goals.

Track Everything That Matters
From weights lifted to streaks maintained — all your data, clearly visualized.

Minimalist & Focused Design
Built for people who want results, not distractions.
